typography.heading_font: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace
typography.code_font: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, source-code-pro, monospace
rules: Use JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono for all terminal outputs, file paths, line numbers, entropy scores, secret values, and code views.
Headings must be crisp and structured with monospace tags like [APKLENS :: DECOMPILED] or [FINDINGS // SECRETS].
Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default fonts.

layout_and_structure.header: Fixed top bar with APKLens logo, active APK job status, quick stats (Total Secrets, URLs, Vulns), and a prominent Global Search Bar (Cmd/Ctrl + K)
layout_and_structure.left_panel: Width ~280px to 320px. Includes: 1. APK File Tree Navigator; 2. Finding Categories list with badge counts (Secrets, Endpoints, Manifest, Crypto, Custom Rules); 3. Job upload trigger button.
layout_and_structure.center_panel: Flex-1 main viewer. Multi-tabbed container supporting: 1. Code Viewer (with line numbers, syntax highlighting, finding hit indicators, jump-to-line highlight animation); 2. Manifest Audit Matrix; 3. Endpoints & URLs table; 4. Custom Rules Manager; 5. Quick Deobfuscator Tool.
layout_and_structure.right_panel: Width ~340px to 380px. Finding Detail Drawer / Inspector. Displays: Full secret/endpoint value (unmasked as per user choice), entropy score, pattern signature, file path & line link, severity badge, triage actions (Confirm / False Positive / Dismiss), and raw context lines.

effects: Subtle 1px borders with dark tinted Slate (#23283B) separating all IDE panels
Code highlight pulse animation when jumping from search or finding detail to exact line in source code viewer
Terminal scanline backdrop overlay for active decompilation / scanning status screens
Glassmorphism modal for Global Search Command Palette (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0A0B10]/80)
Custom dark scrollbars with rounded-none 4px tracks to match terminal aesthetics

component_guidelines.global_search_modal: Instant search overlay triggered by Cmd/Ctrl+K or clicking the top search bar. Filters through decompiled files, extracted secrets, endpoints, and manifest nodes in real-time.
component_guidelines.apk_upload_progress: Drag & drop upload zone with step progress: queued -> decompiling (JADX/apktool status) -> scanning -> complete. Interactive logs drawer.
component_guidelines.source_code_viewer: Monospace code block with line numbering. Highlight finding lines with bright tint (e.g. bg-rose-500/20 border-l-2 border-rose-500). Clicking a line copies file:line reference.
component_guidelines.deobfuscator_drawer: Quick utility tool supporting Base64 decode, Hex decode, URL decode, and ROT13/ROTN with live preview.
component_guidelines.custom_rules_manager: Form to create and test custom regex + Shannon entropy rules with severity assignment and test payload validator.

data_testid_requirements.mandatory_pattern: kebab-case data-testid on every interactive button, tab, search input, filter toggle, code line, and triage action.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never center align the main application layout; use precise IDE panel flex and grid structures.
Always display full secret values without masking, as explicitly selected by user requirements.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes for E2E testing validation.
Ensure global search (Cmd+K) provides sub-millisecond response feedback and immediate jump-to-file capability.
Use sonner for toast notifications when triage actions or rule updates occur.
Maintain strict APCA contrast standards for dark theme legibility across all severity badges and code line numbers.
